note: Synthetic demo fixture. External AI-ecosystem items for the weekly scout — separate from watchlist raw items. Headlines, sources, and URLs are invented for the demo.

items.title: Hyperscaler announces multi-region AI data-center expansion program
items.snippet: A major cloud provider outlined a multi-region data-center expansion focused on AI training capacity, with first sites breaking ground this quarter.

items.title: Rack-density benchmarks shift cooling requirements for AI clusters
items.snippet: New deployment data shows rack densities for AI clusters exceeding prior data-center design envelopes, pushing liquid cooling from optional to default.

items.title: Grid operator opens fast-track interconnection pilot for data centers
items.snippet: A regional grid operator launched a pilot to accelerate interconnection queues for large data-center loads paired with new clean generation.

items.title: Nuclear power purchase agreements trend longer in data-center contracts
items.snippet: Recent power purchase agreements between nuclear operators and data-center developers show longer tenors and firmer capacity commitments.

items.title: Advanced packaging capacity remains the key silicon supply bottleneck
items.snippet: Industry checks continue to identify advanced packaging, not wafer starts, as the binding constraint on AI accelerator supply through next year.

items.title: Next-generation HBM roadmap update points to capacity race
items.snippet: Memory vendors updated high-bandwidth memory roadmaps, signaling an intensifying capacity race tied to accelerator demand.

items.title: Open-source agent-orchestration framework reaches 1.0 release
items.snippet: A widely used open-source framework for orchestrating LLM agent workflows shipped its 1.0 release with stable APIs for tool use and evaluation hooks.

items.title: Workflow automation platform adds native LLM evaluation hooks
items.snippet: A popular workflow automation platform added first-class support for LLM steps with built-in evaluation and structured-output validation.

items.title: Public demo shows schema-validated research agents with audit trails
items.snippet: A public demo walked through schema-validated research agents producing auditable outputs with per-step provenance — a useful pattern to show the team.

items.title: CLI demo turns RSS metadata into a structured signal store
items.snippet: A small open-source CLI demo ingests RSS metadata into a queryable signal store with hashes and source links — worth a look for the research stack.
